messages.subject: building annotation from scratch
parts:
Dear Henrik,

 

I am trying to analyze the mouse diversity chip with aroma.affymetrix and make a comparison with dChip results.

I need to build the UFL UGP ACS files in order to accomplish this task. I have some annotation files from the Jax Laboritory which should contain enough information in order to accomplish the task .

I could not find a complete procedure in the google group on how to do it from scratch.

I would be grateful if you could help in this. Eventually they could be helpful for others.

Thanks,

 

Paolo

UGP Final script:
# Define the Affymetrix CDF File
chipType <- "mDIV";
cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$byChipType(chipType)# ,tags="Full")
# The file will be searched as "GenomeWideSNP_6,Full.cdf"
# inspect imported CDF
print(cdf)
nbrOfUnits(cdf) # or lenght(getUnitNames(cdf))
nbrOfCells(cdf)
nbrOfRows(cdf)
nbrOfColumns(cdf)
# Detect what is your master probe (here is called UNIT!!) ID.
# get a sample of what you will have to deal with as unique identifier
in the
# next steps.
getUnitNames(cdf)[c(1:20,1000:1020,nbrOfUnits(cdf):(nbrOfUnits
(cdf)-20))]
# look for specific suffix
grep ("Exon*" ,getUnitNames(cdf))
length(grep ("Exon*" ,getUnitNames(cdf)))
grep ("Jax*" ,getUnitNames(cdf))
grep ("Sty*" ,getUnitNames(cdf))
# try to inspect the cdf uniqueIDs by building a frequency table by
trunkating
# the names. This will help in looking at what fields you'll have to
parse from
# the annotation files.
z = substr(getUnitNames(cdf),1,2)
freqTable = table(z)
GroupLabels=names(freqTable)
ColVec = as.numeric(as.factor(GroupLabels))
barplot(freqTable, horiz=F, col=ColVec, xlab="Frequency",
ylab="Range")
# or just
pie(freqTable)
#
################################################################################
## Create UGP File
#
# Creates an empty UGP file for the CDF, if missing.
ugp <- AromaUgpFile$allocateFromCdf(cdf, tags="");

# Load the ASCII tabular file which contains the following headers and
relative
# data.
#ProbeSetID Chromosome Physical Position
Strand
#Exon0119476-0 10 3134304 3134328 +
#Exon0119476-1 10 3134304 3134328 -
#Exon0119476-2 10 3134605 3134629 +
#Exon0119476-3 10 3134605 3134629 -
#Exon0119476-4 10 3134884 3134908 +
#Exon0119476-5 10 3134884 3134908 -
#Exon0119477-0 10 3185734 3185758 +
#Exon0119477-1 10 3185734 3185758 -
#Exon0119477-2 10 3185804 3185828 +

#JAX00725095G_3 Y 2634903 +
#JAX00725095G_6 Y 2634903 -
#JAX00725095G_7 Y 2634903 -
#JAX00725095T_0 Y 2634903 +
#JAX00725095T_1 Y 2634903 +
#JAX00725095T_4 Y 2634903 -
#JAX00725095T_5 Y 2634903 -
#
#### I created this file by processing the annotation file I received
and pulling
# out the probe IDs and merging the CN And SNP id files into one (they
came separately)
filenameUgp <- "genomeinfo.txt";
pathUgp <- "annotationData/chipTypes/mDIV/"
datUgp <- TabularTextFile(filenameUgp, path=pathUgp);
print(datUgp);
# Adjust the fields below according to your headercols.
ProbeSetID_upgCol = "^ProbeSetID$"="character" ;
Chrom_ugpCol = "^Chromosome$"="character";
PhysPos_ugpCol = "^Physical Position$"="integer" ;

(ProbeSetID_upgCol,Chrom_ugpCol,PhysPos_ugpCol), colOrder=c
(1,2,3),na.strings="NA" );

#Exon0147205-0 12 NA NA +
#Exon0147205-1 12 NA NA -
#Exon0147205-2 12 NA NA +
#Exon0147205-3 12 NA NA -
#Exon0147205-4 12 NA NA +
#[...]

#
#The default is na.strings="---". Yes, this is a bit odd; seems to be
#a remnant from old times. I might update that later.

# check output
str(units)
table(ugp[,1])

rm (datUgp)
